title: Hall inlet air temperature swings 20-25C over the day, tracking outdoor temperature

expected.reason: Daily cycle that matches outdoor temperature and stays inside the ASHRAE recommended 18-27C band. Switch temps follow by 2C. Repeats every day.
suppressionEvidence: matches same-hour baseline from prior days

glossary.ASHRAE: Industry body whose guidelines set recommended data hall air temperatures (18-27C).

context.note: Baselines need time-of-day seasonality, not a flat mean.
